url_validation: Must start with http:// or https://. Reject javascript:, data:, etc. Limit length.
ssrf_analysis: Risk identical to text URL input. Ensure backend blocks private/loopback IPs.
image_security: Images processed entirely in browser. No server attack surface.
camera_recommendation: Supported, but must explicitly stop stream after successful decode to protect privacy.
regression_requirements: Model, features, existing endpoints, and extension remain UNCHANGED.
